faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MNNIT Allahabad Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Junior Research Fellow post at MNNIT Allahabad is 15 August 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications are sent via email before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Junior Research Fellow posts at MNNIT Allahabad?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow position in the MNNIT Allahabad Recruitment 2026. This is a single post opportunity for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for MNNIT Allahabad Junior Research Fellow Recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Junior Research Fellow post at MNNIT Allahabad is Email. Candidates need to send their complete application along with required documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Junior Research Fellow position at MNNIT Allahabad?
faq.answer: The salary for the Junior Research Fellow is Rs. 37,000 per month + 20% HRA for the first two years, and Rs. 42,000 per month + 20% HRA for the third year.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an M.E./M.Tech. in Electronics Engineering or allied relevant branches with GATE qualification, or a B.E./B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering with GATE qualification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for MNNIT Allahabad Junior Research Fellow Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position includes shortlisting based on merit, followed by an interview. Candidates will be informed about the interview schedule after shortlisting.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for MNNIT Allahabad Junior Research Fellow Recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the MNNIT Allahabad Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026. Applications are free of cost.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Junior Research Fellow position is Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 211004. The institute is Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology Allahabad.

faq.question: Q9. What type of job is this at MNNIT Allahabad?
faq.answer: This is a Contractual job type. The Junior Research Fellow position at MNNIT Allahabad is offered on a contract basis, as specified in the official notification.

faq.answer: The official notification can be found on the official website of Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology Allahabad (MNNIT Allahabad) at http://www.mnnit.ac.in. A direct link is also provided in the Important Links section.
